hypothesis: A training-derived bank of evidence-bounded conditional procedures can produce repeat-observed new-case acquisition beyond unchanged H0 and a fixed generic procedure prompt. This tests the composite method, not a causal decomposition of quality filtering, retrieval or successful/error sources.

selection.A_train: All 24 A training cases from v9 in their frozen order; include all correct and benchmark-discordant attempts. Never promote benchmark labels to adjudicated medical truth.
selection.development_selection: Metadata and known-image-source disjoint from all prior used and reserved cases, including 96 protected v9 confirmation cases; freeze membership before labels. No expansion or resampling.
selection.B_training: Not run in v10; v9 B sources are preserved for feedback under actual frozen H_A only after this A-acquisition gate passes.

method.input: Original A source question/images, first H0 attempt and semantic target text. No development data.
method.memory: One candidate conditional procedural note per source. Preserve acceptance and rejection; synthesize admitted notes once into HCL main_policy and failure_avoidance slots, retaining admitted source-index provenance. Model assessment is not medical validation.
method.retrieval: At most two notes; require two distinct non-generic cue tokens shared with current question, rank Jaccard then memory ID. No inference-time learning.
method.generation_failure: Malformed schema or unexpected tools stops without regeneration. Zero admitted candidates ends without evaluation; otherwise exactly one consolidation call yielding two valid policies.
method.consolidation: One text-only call after the 24 image-conditioned candidate calls; only admitted candidates, no development data or new external medical knowledge. Preserve source indices and conditional uncertainty.

execution.order: All states frozen before evaluation. Within each case rotate three arms, fresh agent/session; repeat 2 reverses case order and shifts arm order. Every arm physically rerun, no aliases.
execution.fixed: Sol High subscription, six author tools/defaults, original case input and two-turn final-letter scoring. Generic prompt is a prespecified scientific control, not tuned after development.
execution.development_gold: Sealed before generation; read only after all predictions or termination. All unrun/invalid outcomes remain in full denominators.

gate.per_repeat: H_A net gain >=2/24 vs H0, H0 losses <=1/24, net gain >=1/24 vs fixed generic, in BOTH repeat blocks; all 144 valid and >=2 acquired cases H0 wrong/H_A correct in both blocks.
gate.pass_action: Only a development signal: next independently frozen B update under H_A and coeval H0/H_A/H_AB replay with retention criteria. Confirmation untouched.
gate.fail_action: Stop this frozen variant; retain null/harm/headroom/retrieval evidence. No prompt rewrite, regeneration, new panels or relaxed threshold in this experiment.
gate.statistics: Full paired tables and exact descriptive McNemar per block. Do not multiply repeated cases into independent N; no confirmatory p-value or no-forgetting claim.
gate.headroom: Report if any control/repeat has too few errors for the frozen gain gate; never loosen it.

limitations: 24 training cases and one generation per case, one source bank, two stochastic inference repeats, no independent bank or full-stream replication.
Composite change vs v8: all A training traces, model acceptance, two-slot consolidation and conditional retrieval; no isolated causal attribution.
Source supervision and generated notes not clinically adjudicated.
Generic and learned context length/coverage and generation costs differ; report all.
Development-only A acquisition; neither sequential B learning nor retention established.
public_boundary: Source/protocol/aggregates/cost only; no questions/images/gold/source IDs/notes/per-case predictions/credentials.
